*Incident report — Ava Ivy (Sexi Dev) Discord spaz*
*When:* 2026-07-31 · *Where:* RootMC Discord `#general` (`1516108586307158088`)
*Status:* Bot offline while fixes land · *Severity:* Chat spam / UX only (no server/economy impact)

*What happened*
Ava flooded `#general` with near-duplicate replies (Grok/D1/file-access status repeated), kept talking after “Stop Ava,” and felt all over the place.

*Root cause*
1. *Restart backlog* — in-memory `seen` wiped on restart → poller re-answered old Ava pings
2. *Loose triggers* — bare “Ava” matched too easily
3. *No real hush state* — “stop Ava” was just another reply
4. *No ack* — long Cursor/Grok work dumped full essays with no “give me a sec”
*Fix (wired in `rootmc-sexi` 0.4, not running yet)*
• Boot = *one offline summary* + *“sorry I was asleep / I’m active”* (no per-ping backlog)
• Persisted seen/watermarks + hush/stop
• Tighter Ava/@Sexi triggers
• *Ack first* (in-character: “mmmm..... idk.... let me search that for you”) then *one* Cursor answer
• Grok unplugged — Cursor-only; handoff drop zone `Server Handoffs/Ava Ivy/`
*Next*
Turn her back on with `npm start` in `Web Files/rootmc-sexi` when ready to verify the boot handshake in `#general`. *Sent using* Cursor
